paragraphs: We are a bank holding company headquartered in Jefferson City, Missouri. As of December 31, 2025, we had total consolidated balance sheet assets of $20.75 billion and wealth assets under advice of $16.0 billion. Through our full-service community banking subsidiary, The Central Trust Bank, we provide a comprehensive suite of consumer, commercial and wealth management products and services to our communities, which are primarily located in Missouri, Kansas, Oklahoma and Colorado. As of December 31, 2025, we operated 155 full-service branch locations, with a consolidated weighted average deposit market share of approximately 24%. Our business model is designed to serve the holistic financial services needs of businesses, individuals, agencies and community organizations within our footprint. Our goal is simple: to provide legendary service to our customers and to be an integral part in the success of our customers and the communities we serve. Our success is driven by our long-term commitment to the markets we serve and our culture of customer service excellence.

Our Company was founded in January 1902 under the leadership of the great grandfather of our current Executive Chairman, S. Bryan Cook. During the Great Depression, we made a loan to the State of Missouri to assist it with making payroll and paying other expenses and we currently have an extensive relationship with the state. From 2008 to 2012, while in the depths of the Great Recession, we earned an annual return on average assets of at least 1.00%.

We believe the continuity of our ownership over our 124-year history of operating has fostered an enduring culture that has consistently proven successful in the marketplace and will position us well for future growth. This culture has allowed us to attract and retain great talent. Our employees are experienced (average 8-year tenure as of December 31, 2025), engaged (81% completed our most recent survey) and committed (86% would recommend working at the bank and 88% would recommend our products, each based on our most recent survey). Combined with our investments in products, services and technologies, we believe our culture has appealed to our customers and enabled us to increase market share. The core tenets of our culture, which we seek to quantify and hold ourselves accountable to, require us to be:

•Customer Centric: We focus on customer satisfaction and attracting and retaining customers for the long-term. Our latest Net Promoter Score was 74, based on our most recent customer survey, which we believe is as much as two times the average for U.S. retail banks. We have been able to grow the number of households we serve by an average of 3% per year since 2016, and believe we have the ability to continue to do so at a greater rate than our peers. Additionally, our deposit customers had an average tenure of 13 years as of December 31, 2025, and we were named Newsweek's Best Customer Service Bank in 2023 (the only year this ranking was published).
•Community Aligned: We emphasize giving back to the communities we serve. We track our community services hours, which totaled over 29,000 in 2025, or approximately 10 hours per employee.

•Committed to the Long Term: As we have grown, our capital ratios and balance sheet liquidity metrics have exceeded the regulatory requirements and threshold for "well capitalized" status. We continuously reinvest in our business and are currently undertaking a banking core modernization project that is intended to provide us with real-time, API-based capabilities. As a testament to our success, we were ranked the #9 Best Bank by Forbes in 2026 and are one of only two banks to have been in the Top 50 in every year since Forbes began its rankings in 2009.

•Collaborative to Succeed: We maintain a community banking model led by experienced leaders in each of our markets that are empowered to make local decisions, which requires accountability and collaboration with our senior leaders and business line managers. Our collaborative contract is embodied in the "Central Code," which we renew periodically.
1Source: S&P Global Market Intelligence, as of June 30, 2025. The peer median references the 50 banks included in the KBW Nasdaq Regional Banking Index.
2Net Promoter Score represents Central Bancompany's 2025 figure based on our most recent customer survey for Consumer, Commercial and Wealth businesses weighted by number of responses.

Our vision is to become the leading financial services provider in each community we serve. To accomplish this vision, we strive to offer service levels better than other community banks and products, services and technologies consistent with the largest banks in the industry. We capture this ambition in our slogan, "Strong Roots, Endless Possibilities," and manage our Company around these dual objectives.

The "Strong Roots" portion of our slogan is representative of our 11 "Primary Markets" and the 79 communities that we serve, as well as the executives that lead them, many of whom are long term residents of the communities in which they are employed. The following table lists our "Primary Markets":

paragraphs: The material risks and uncertainties that management believes affect us are described below. •We engage in lending secured by real estate and may be forced to foreclose on the collateral, subjecting us to costs and potential risks associated with foreclosure and the ownership of real property.
•We are subject to a variety of risks in connection with any sale of loans we may conduct.

paragraphs: On April 28, 2025, our amended Articles became effective, pursuant to which we (i) increased the number of authorized shares of our capital stock to 600,000,000, consisting of 500,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, 50,000,000 shares of Class B common stock, and 50,000,000 shares of preferred stock, (ii) decreased the par value of each class of our capital stock to $0.01 per share and (iii) automatically reclassified and converted each share of Class B common stock then outstanding (excluding treasury stock) into one share of Class A common stock. The effect of the Reclassification on outstanding shares and per share figures has been retroactively applied to all periods presented. See "Note 20, Capital Structure, Share Reclassification, Stock Split Effective in the Form of a Stock Dividend," to our audited consolidated financial statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

On October 9, 2025, the Company declared a 50-for-1 stock split of the Company's common stock in the form of a stock dividend, entitling each shareholder of record to receive 49 additional shares of common stock for every one share owned. The record date for the stock dividend is October 20, 2025, with a distribution date for the new shares of October 24, 2025. The par value per share of our common stock remains $0.01 per share. The effect of the stock split on outstanding shares and per share figures has been retroactively applied to all periods presented. See "Note 20, Capital Structure, Share Reclassification, Stock Split Effective in the Form of a Stock Dividend," to our audited consolidated financial statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

On November 19, 2025, in connection with its IPO, the Company completed an offering of 17,778,000 shares of Class A common stock at a public offering price of $21.00 per share. On December 3, 2025, the underwriters exercised their option to purchase an additional 2,666,700 shares of Class A common stock at the same offering price. The Company received total net proceeds of approximately $403.1 million, after deducting underwriting discounts, commissions, and estimated offering expenses. The Company's common stock is currently listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbol "CBC."

paragraphs: 本公司為一家銀行控股公司，總部設於密蘇裏州傑斐遜城。截至2025年12月31日，本公司合併財務報表之總資產為20.75十億美元，並管理著16.0十億美元的財富資產。透過我們的全功能社區銀行子公司The Central Trust Bank，我們為所服務的社區提供完整的消費者、企業及財富管理產品與服務，這些社區主要位於密蘇裏州、堪薩斯州、奧克拉荷馬州與科羅拉多州。截至2025年12月31日，本公司經營155個全功能分行據點，合併加權平均存款市場佔有率約為24%。我們的商業模式旨在服務我們所服務地區內企業、個人、機構與社區組織的整體金融服務需求。我們的目標很簡單：為客戶提供卓越的服務，並成為客戶與所服務社區成功的重要一環。我們的成功源於我們對所服務市場的長期承諾與我們卓越的客戶服務文化。
本公司於1902年1月成立，由現任執行主席S. Bryan Cook的祖父領導。在大蕭條時期，我們向密蘇裏州政府貸款，協助其發放薪資與支付其他開支，我們目前與該州有廣泛的合作關係。從2008年至2012年，當時正值大衰退時期，我們平均資產的年回報率至少為1.00%。

我們相信在過去124年的經營歷史中，我們的股權連續性已培養出一種持續在市場上表現成功的文化，並為未來的成長奠定良好基礎。這種文化使我們能吸引並留住優秀人才。我們的員工經驗豐富（截至2025年12月31日，平均服務年資為8年），投入度高（81%完成我們最近的問卷調查），並具備忠誠心（86%會推薦在銀行工作，88%會推薦我們的產品，均根據我們最近的問卷調查）。結合我們在產品、服務與科技上的投資，我們相信這種文化已吸引客戶，並使我們能增加市場佔有率。我們文化的核心價值觀，我們致力於量化並對自己負責，要求我們做到：

•以客戶為中心：我們專注於客戶滿意度，並長期吸引與留住客戶。我們最近的淨推薦指數為74，根據我們最近的客戶問卷調查，我們認為這約為美國零售銀行平均值的兩倍。自2016年起，我們平均每年能增加服務的戶數3%，我們相信我們有能力以比同業更高的速度持續成長。此外，截至2025年12月31日，我們的存款客戶平均服務年資為13年，我們在2023年被《新聞週刊》評選為最佳客戶服務銀行（這是該排名唯一發佈的年份）。
•與社區共成長：我們強調回饋我們所服務的社區。我們追蹤社區服務時數，2025年總計超過29,000小時，約為每位員工10小時。
•致力於長期發展：隨著我們的成長，我們的資本比率與資產負債表流動性指標已超過監管要求的"資本充足"標準。我們持續投資於業務，目前正進行銀行核心系統現代化計畫，旨在提供我們即時、基於API的作業能力。作為我們成功的見證，我們在2026年被《福布斯》評選為第9名最佳銀行，並是僅有兩家銀行中，自2009年《福布斯》開始評選以來，每一年均進入前50名的銀行之一。
•合作以成功：我們維持一種由各市場經驗豐富的領導者帶領的社區銀行模式，這些領導者被賦予做出地方決策的權力，這需要與我們高階領導者與業務線經理進行責任與合作。我們的合作契約體現在"Central Code"中，我們會定期更新。
1來源：S&P Global Market Intelligence，截至2025年6月30日。同儕中位數參考KBW Nasdaq Regional Banking Index中包含的50家銀行。
2Net Promoter Score 代表 Central Bancompany 在 2025 年的指標，係根據我們最近一次針對 Consumer、Commercial 及 Wealth 事業的客戶問卷調查結果，並根據回應數量進行加權計算。
我們的願景是成為我們服務的每個社區中領先的金融服務提供者。為達成此願景，我們致力於提供比其他社區銀行更優質的服務水準，以及與產業內最大銀行相符合的產品、服務與科技。我們將此雄心體現在口號 "Strong Roots, Endless Possibilities" 中，並以這兩個雙重目標來經營本公司。
口號中的 "Strong Roots" 部分，代表我們的 11 個 "Primary Markets" 以及我們服務的 79 個社區，以及領導這些社區的高階主管，其中許多為長期居住於其服務社區的居民。下述表格列出我們的 "Primary Markets"：

paragraphs: 於 2025 年 4 月 28 日，本公司修正後的章程生效，根據此章程，本公司 (i) 將已發行資本股票的 authorised shares 數量增至 600,000,000 份，包含 500,000,000 份 Class A 普通股、50,000,000 份 Class B 普通股及 50,000,000 份優先股，(ii) 將各類資本股票的票面價值降低為每份 0.01 美元，及 (iii) 自動將當時已發行（不包含庫藏股）的 Class B 普通股每份轉換為 1 份 Class A 普通股。此轉換對已發行股份及每股金額的影響已回溯適用於所有呈報期間。詳見 "Note 20, Capital Structure, Share Reclassification, Stock Split Effective in the Form of a Stock Dividend," 本公司經審計之合併財務報表於本年度報告 10-K 表單中。

於 2025 年 10 月 9 日，本公司宣佈以股票股息形式進行 50:1 的普通股拆股，使每持有 1 份普通股的股東可獲發 49 份額外普通股。股票股息的登記日為 2025 年 10 月 20 日，新股份發放日為 2025 年 10 月 24 日。本公司普通股的票面價值仍為每份 0.01 美元。此拆股對已發行股份及每股金額的影響已回溯適用於所有呈報期間。詳見 "Note 20, Capital Structure, Share Reclassification, Stock Split Effective in the Form of a Stock Dividend," 本公司經審計之合併財務報表於本年度報告 10-K 表單中。

於 2025 年 11 月 19 日，本公司在進行首次公開發行（IPO）時，完成了 17,778,000 份 Class A 普通股的發行，發行價格為每股 21.00 美元。於 2025 年 12 月 3 日，經紀人行使其選擇權，以相同發行價格購入額外 2,666,700 份 Class A 普通股。本公司總計收到淨資金約 403.1 百萬美元，扣除經紀人折扣、佣金及預估發行費用後。本公司普通股目前於 Nasdaq 股票市場上市，股票代碼為 "CBC"。

paragraphs: 本公司管理階層認為影響我們的主要風險與不確定性已於下文描述。除本報告中所列其他資訊外，您應謹慎考量下文所述的風險與不確定性。任何下列風險，以及我們尚未知悉或目前認為不重要之風險，均可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。此外，若本報告中任何資訊屬於展望性陳述，則下列風險因素為警示性陳述，識別可能導致實際結果與本公司或代表本公司所作之展望性陳述產生重大差異的重要因素。請參閱本年度10-K表報中之『展望性陳述警示說明』。
•本公司可能無法適當衡量與管理信用風險，這可能會對本公司之獲利造成不利影響。
•本公司之信用損失撥備可能不足以吸收貸款與租賃組閤中潛在之損失。
•本公司在評估與監控實物與個人財產時所使用之評估與其他估值技術可能不正確。
•本公司從事以不動產為擔保之貸款業務，並可能被迫對擔保品進行拍賣，使本公司面臨拍賣與不動產所有權相關之成本與潛在風險。
•本公司在進行貸款銷售時，可能面臨多種相關風險。
